<!--
### ❓ First time contributing to GeoPandas? Read this!

Thank you for contributing!

Some things to check:

- The contributing docs: https://geopandas.org/en/latest/community/contributing.html

- While we allow AI assisted PRs, we are not interested in fully automated contributions from accounts with no interest in GeoPandas. If you are using AI to assist with this contribution:
  - Ensure to read the guidelines on AI assisted contributions: https://geopandas.org/en/latest/community/contributing.html#ai-assisted-contributions
  - Write the PR description yourself. That is a good exercise to verify the understanding of what you are contributing. And in general we expect you to write all communication (comments) yourself.

- We encourage you to introduce yourself. We don't need to know personal details, but: how did you get to contribute? How are you using GeoPandas in your own workflows?
We are a community of mostly volunteers, and getting to know you helps us trust your judgement and welcome you into the community.
